text.p: Lithuania's statistics department said on Tuesday that the country's foreign trade deficit was 1.537 billion litas in the first quarter of this year compared to 873 million litas in the same period last year.
The department also said in a statement that the country's trade deficit in March was 621.7 million kroons compared to 451 million litas the previous year.

The department said that exports in the first quarter of the year amounted to 3.328 billion litas and imports were 4.865 billion litas. The figures for the first quarter last year were 3.024 billion litas and 3.897 billion litas respectively.
Exports in March of this year were 1.169 billion litas and imports were 1.791 billion litas. The figures for March of 1996 were 1.118 billion litas and 1.569 billion litas respectively.
